findings.title: Trees Enter the Writing Apparatus

findings.containment: The verse states a hypothetical identity between trees and pens. Cutting and dressing are an interpretive development from the pen root, not separately narrated actions; no literal harvest of every tree is asserted.

epistemic.reason: The channel evidence is trusted and the tree-to-pen relation is explicit in the hypothetical; the manufacturing sequence is a bounded root-based elaboration.

findings.title: Non-Exhaustion Beside Truth and Falsehood
findings.claim: The next ayah’s opposition between what is true and what is false lets the focus’s non-exhaustion carry a secondary resonance of non-expiring truth, alongside its material image of words not running out.
findings.mechanism: The focus words, negated depletion, and wisdom adjective are the carriers. The true/false contrast in 31:30 independently activates durability: what is fixed against falsehood remains, while what departs from truth can be removed. The focus’s non-exhaustion is thereby heard qualitatively as well as quantitatively.
findings.reader_payoff: The scale image gains a durability dimension: the words do not merely exceed available materials; they also stand with what remains true.
findings.containment: The context does not say that every assertion made by people is false or that 31:27 is only about truth. The ordinary quantitative reading remains fully present.

friction_notes: All HFT records are legacy_unbound: supplied Arabic confirms surface contact, while their target segmentation, word indices, roots, branches, and roles remain attributed unless independently registered. Unresolved branches are kept without invented glosses or facets.
The three channel findings are bounded to the focus writing image; no recurrence across the pericope is asserted from their focus-only supports.
The 31:28 scale reversal, 31:29 bounded cycles, and 31:30 truth contrast coexist as contextual readings; none is selected as the single explanation of 31:27.
The 31:31–32 sea sequence retains its navigation, rescue, and human-response sense. Its link to persistent legibility is secondary, and the focus words are not equated with signs.
The 31:34 future reading may concern divine knowledge alone; treating its listed contingencies as contents of the focus words remains exploratory.
The 31:33 accountability context does not itself develop the writing metaphor; the nonfungibility comparison remains an exploratory analogy.
The saline-water reading is analogical and attributed. The focus does not literally say the sea thirsts or explicitly call it salty; the incompatible salt-pit collocation on يمدّ is excluded.
The repeated-earth observation uses the closing ayah’s exact supplied surface, but its contextual word morphology is not supplied and the connection may be no more than a general transcendence theme.
